title: Champion of the Naaru: Trials across Outland
summary: A’dal’s summons carries adventurers across Outland through mercy, strength and tenacity, toward Magtheridon and the gate of Tempest Keep.
opening: A letter from Khadgar reaches Shattrath with news from Shadowmoon. The naaru who once left their vessel now see a danger within it, and ask who is ready to face it.

chapters.title: The warning at Shattrath
chapters.body:
After the Cipher of Damnation was recovered, a letter from Khadgar called the seeker to Shattrath. A’dal saw a danger in Kael’thas that could no longer be left unanswered. The road turned from Shadowmoon toward Tempest Keep. The naaru who had once judged a return to their vessel unnecessary now sought help against the threat within its walls.

Tempest Keep had been made by the naaru. Now Kael’thas threatened to use the Cipher of Damnation, and A’dal called for those who could stop him. Four trials stood before the undertaking. Across Outland, mercy, strength and tenacity would be demanded of the adventurers before they faced the dangers of the vessel. The summons was a beginning; the Keep’s reckoning still lay ahead.

chapters.title: Four trials across Outland
chapters.body:
In the Shattered Halls, Kargath held three prisoners beneath the threat of execution. A’dal called for their rescue. Amid the fortress’s violence, mercy required that living captives be brought beyond the executioner’s reach. An unused axe, its blade without blood, was carried back as proof. The cold iron marked the danger from which the prisoners had been sought.

In the flooded works of the Steamvault, Warlord Kalithresh stood against the seeker. His defeat and the recovery of his trident formed one half of a single test of strength. Beneath Coilfang’s waters, the challenge left its proof in a weapon carried away. Elsewhere in Outland, another force awaited those whom A’dal had called.

The other half of the trial lay in Auchindoun’s Shadow Labyrinth. There Murmur, a being from beyond this plane, had to be confronted. Its defeat yielded an essence to return to A’dal. In the shadowed halls, strength met a power unlike Kalithresh’s. Both burdens belonged to the same trial, though each demanded its own encounter.

In the Arcatraz, dangerous beings were held aboard Tempest Keep. Among them was Millhouse Manastorm, a gnome whom A’dal described as a stowaway caught upon the wrong vessel. The seeker had to rescue him and keep him alive. Tenacity now bore the weight of another life, carried through a prison whose perils could not be escaped by resolve alone.

Then Magtheridon remained. A’dal called for an army and sent it deep beneath Hellfire Citadel, into the pit lord’s lair. The gathered force fought through the chamber and defeated the corrupter. The naaru approved. Yet the victory beneath Hellfire had not settled the danger in Tempest Keep; Kael’thas still waited beyond the road these trials were opening.

chapters.title: The key and the waiting danger
chapters.body:
With the last trial complete, A’dal granted the Tempest Key. The way into the Eye, at the heart of Tempest Keep, could now open. Across Outland, the seeker had carried proof from threatened prisoners, flooded halls, a shadowed labyrinth and a prison in the sky. Those trials ended at a threshold. Beyond it, the struggle against Kael’thas remained.

Above Netherstorm stood the vessel to which all these trials had pointed. The Tempest Key was won, but the foe within had yet to be faced. A’dal’s summons had carried the seeker across a broken world and brought the journey to this gate. Here readiness met the unfinished danger, and the hope entrusted to the adventurers awaited the battle to come.

reviewNote: Complete nine-scene illustrated research story with original paraphrase, transcript-matched AI narration, source/claim/citation records per node, TBC-matched reused dungeon art, new named-figure/object art, and a dedicated Magtheridon environment. The story begins after Oronok’s Cipher of Damnation and does not retell his chain. Mercy, Strength and Tenacity are parallel requirements; Strength is one trial with two named targets. The title condition is kept separate from The Tempest Key and is patch-sensitive. Original-client quest/build capture, area/model resemblance review, human lore approval, exact title eligibility by original patch and narration audition remain open. No record is reviewed or published.
